name: Lead & Deal Watcher: Fetch, Score, Sheet, Notify

nodes.name: Every Hour
nodes.notes: Runs the pipeline once per hour. Change to minutes/days here. This is the only trigger: no manual credentials needed to start.

nodes.name: Fetch Source
nodes.notes: Fetches raw items from any JSON HTTP/API/RSS-to-JSON source. Default demo source = Hacker News Algolia API (no auth). Override with an n8n variable SOURCE_URL, or hardcode your own endpoint / add credentials in the node.

nodes.name: Normalize
nodes.notes: Flattens the source payload into one clean item per row. This is the ONE place you adapt the template to a new source: change the field mapping and you are done.

nodes.name: Filter Relevant
nodes.notes: Keeps only items worth acting on (has URL, meets a minimum score). Tune the thresholds to control volume and cost of the AI step below.

nodes.name: AI Score (HTTP)
nodes.notes: Enriches each item with an AI relevance score via a generic HTTP call (works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Set a Header Auth credential with 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>'. Swap the URL/model for Anthropic, OpenRouter, Groq, or a local LLM. Can be deleted if you only need a rule-based score.

nodes.name: Merge Score
nodes.notes: Parses the AI JSON, attaches score + reason to the original item, and computes a HOT/WARM/COLD tier used both for the Sheet row and the notification.

nodes.name: Save to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Upserts each scored item into a sheet (append or update on matching 'id', so re-runs do not duplicate rows). Header row must contain: id, title, url, aiScore, tier, aiReason, fetchedAt.

nodes.name: Only HOT
nodes.notes: Gate so you are only pinged for high-value items. Remove this node to be notified about everything, or change the tier.

nodes.name: Notify Discord
nodes.notes: Posts HOT items to a Discord (or Slack) incoming webhook. For Slack use its webhook URL and change the body to { text: ... }. Set DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL as an n8n variable or paste the URL here.
